Subject: MSA redline triage + vendor onboarding pulse

Hi Natalie —

Quick pulse from our side after reviewing the redlines you sent last night. High level: most commercial terms look aligned, but legal flagged three areas that need brief discussion before we can finalize the MSA and push the order form into procurement provisioning.

Top items:
- Data residency language (Section 4.2): Acme asks for EU residency for certain PHI subsets — we support region pinning but need to confirm how this maps to the private deployment option and whether it should be an order form addendum.
- Indemnity carveouts (Section 9): Your counters add a third-party carveout we haven't seen — legal suggests clarifying the scope and time-boxing it to integrations we ship.
- Termination for convenience (Section 12): Acme requests 30-day notice with pro-rated credits; our standard is 60-day with pro-rated refunds only in certain committed packages.

Attached: redlined_MSA_v3.docx with inline notes, and a draft order form (order_form_draft.pdf).

Proposed next steps (short):
1) 30-minute triage call this week to align on the three bullets above (owners noted below)
2) If we align, we will iterate the MSA one final time and hand to procurement for vendor setup (target: vendor onboarding checklist complete within 10 business days)

Owners suggested:
- Data residency: Rishi (technical & deployment)
- Indemnity wording: Lauren (legal partner / sales legal)
- Termination/financials: Olga (commercial lead)

Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call Tue/Wed (Apr 6–7) and whether Jason from your integrations team should join?

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear summary. Quick replies inline: 

- Data residency: yes, Acme needs EU residency for European patient data. Jason (cc'd) is the best person to confirm expected traffic and whether the private deployment is required or a SaaS region restriction is sufficient.
- Indemnity: we'll take a run at narrowing the carveout. Our legal prefers language that limits vendor liability for partner-delivered components, but we can be specific about which integrations.
- Termination: 30 days is their ask; they are willing to discuss a short credit schedule if we need a middle ground.

We can do Tue, Apr 6 at 10am PT for the triage call — Jason will join.

Also attaching Acme's preferred vendor setup template (vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx) — it's the form procurement uses to create vendors in their system.

-Natalie

Thanks for the heads-up. A few technical notes to bring to the call:
- EU residency can be achieved via our dedicated EU region for production workloads — requires either Dedicated or Private deployment. SaaS region selection alone isn't sufficient for PHI-scope requirements because of backup/replication controls.
- For onboarding timeline: if legal redlines are agreed in the next 48 hours and procurement completes the vendor form the same week, the earliest private deployment prep (network & KMS) is ~3–4 weeks. If Acme is open to Dedicated capacity instead, we can shorten to ~10 business days for a gated pilot.

Action items before Tue call:
- Lauren: prepare proposed indemnity language options (two variants: narrow carveout, broader partner exception)
- Olga: pull together the commercial fallbacks we can offer for termination (sample credit schedule)
- Rishi: prepare a short deployment options slide (Dedicated vs Private) with timelines

I'll be on the call Tue 10am PT.

-Rishi
